svg.data-power-input-dc: -40 to -72 VDC into two DC PEM-3 (175 A breaker each), two feeds per PEM-3; one PEM-3 carries the system, two give 1+1
svg.data-rated-voltage-dc: -40 to -72 VDC; PEM-3 6480 W at -40 to -72 VDC, up to 8837.5 W at -50.5 to -72 VDC
svg.data-power-input-ac: none on the chassis; external rectifier shelves (OmniOn L20 3HE20675AA, Eltek HM1J 3HE04172AA) feed the PEM-3 terminals
svg.data-operating-temp: 5 C to 40 C; short-term -5 C to 55 C
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 72.07 dBA at low fan RPM (3300), 84.51 at high (6000), 92.07 at full (7900), with PEM-3s and Enhanced Fan Trays
svg.data-altitude: 60 m below to 1800 m above sea level at 40 C; 1800 to 4000 m at 30 C

Its MDA slot 2 holds an MDA-e whose label is not legible; it is drawn as a second ME1-100GB-CFP2, which is a guess. Slots 5 and 7-10 are not in the photographs and show the bay defaults (gap unseen-lab-slots). The chassis is the legacy Alcatel-Lucent one, bezel printed 7750 SR-12 Service Router.","kind":"example","source":"owner lab photographs, working/intake/nokia/7750-sr/photos/lab-2026-09-24"}},"datasheet":{"sha256":"583b58e9d478cf2d16b5724f376b56907526b4124f8ef0953d8bdee42f1e6524","title":"7450 ESS-12 and 7750 SR-12 Chassis Installation Guide Release 22.7, 3HE 18644 AAAA TQZZA Edition 03"},"description":"The 14RU Nokia 7750 SR-12 service router (and the 7450 ESS-12, the same chassis booted as a switch), a DC-only midplane chassis with twelve VERTICAL module slots across the front, printed 1 2 3 4 5 A B 6 7 8 9 10: ten IOM/IMM slots with the two SF/CPM slots A and B in the middle. Cable-management trays with covers run above and below the card cage, each under a strip printing the slot numbers, and the filtered air-intake vent faceplate closes the bottom of the front. Rear: a grounding plate across the top carrying two studs, three vertical Enhanced Fan Trays and two horizontal DC PEM-3s at the bottom. Every card is authored horizontal and seated here at rotate 90 (clockwise), which puts MDA slot 1 at the top as the guide says.","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"The lab photographs show the front only (slots 1-5, A, B and 6). The rear colour and finish, and the ground plate, are read off vendor line art.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["rear"],"wanted":"one straight-on photograph of the SR-12 rear","what":"rear-photographs"},{"note":"p90 Table 25 gives the chassis 25.4 in deep without the cable-management unit and 30.1 in with it, but no figure dimensions how far the trays or their covers stand proud of the card cage, so the covers are drawn flat on the face.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["front"],"wanted":"a side elevation of the chassis with the cable-management trays fitted","what":"cable-tray-depth"},{"note":"Only isometrics (p125 rack mounting, p128 Figure 23) show the sides; nothing draws the top or the underside.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["left","right","top","bottom"],"wanted":"side elevations or photographs of the sides","what":"side-top-bottom"},{"note":"The lab photographs cover slots 1 to 6 and A/B; slot 5 is hidden behind cabling and slots 7-10 are out of frame, so the lab-2026-09-24 configuration does not record them and they show the bay defaults.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["slot-5","slot-7","slot-8","slot-9","slot-10"],"wanted":"a photograph of the lab chassis's slots 5 and 7-10, and the label of slot 6's MDA 2","what":"unseen-lab-slots"}],"groups":{"air-filters":{"description":"the air-filter tray at the bottom of the front, whose vent faceplate is the air intake (p81)","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Filter"},"card-slots":{"description":"the ten vertical IOM/IMM slots, printed 1-5 left of the SF/CPMs and 6-10 right of them (rel-pos = the printed number). An IOM carries two MDAs, MDA slot 1 at the TOP and slot 2 at the bottom (SR-12 guide p46). IOM5-e needs fabric-speed-c, which means the -B chassis 3HE10768AA with SFM6-7/12 (p61-63); IOM3-XP and other FP2 cards fail at fabric-speed-b and -c (p57, p63). Empty slots take an impedance panel (p81).","index-origin":1,"role":"traffic","term":"Slot"},"fans":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"3+0","redundancy-note":"SR-12 guide p84: \"Three fan trays are required for normal operation\"; p80: a single fan failure raises a Critical Fan Failed alarm and the whole tray must be replaced at once, and the chassis runs safely without a tray for up to 2 min at 35 C. Three trays, all needed and none spare, is 3+0"},"description":"three vertical Enhanced Fan Tray slots across the rear, 1 at the left as seen from behind (p78); the trays are interchangeable and hot-swappable, two fans in each","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Fan Tray"},"grounding":{"description":"the front ESD plug receptacle at the bottom right, on the air-filter vent faceplate (p47 key 9)","index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Point"},"pems":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"1+1","redundancy-note":"SR-12 guide p77: \"One PEM -3 can support the full system's electrical current requirements if you are operating the chassis without power redundancy\", at least one must be fitted, and \"For redundancy, you must install two PEM-3s.\" p69 calls them hot-swappable, load-sharing PEM-3s."},"description":"two horizontal DC PEM-3 slots at the bottom of the rear, 1 at the top (p46). Each PEM-3 takes two -48 V feeds; the pair load-share and either carries the chassis (1+1, p77).","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"PEM"},"sfm-slots":{"description":"the two centre slots A (rel-pos 1) and B (rel-pos 2) for the switch fabric / control processor: SFM5-12 + CPM5, SFM6-7/12 + CPM5, or the integrated SF/CPM3-12 / SF/CPM4-12. One is required; two give redundancy, and in a redundant system the two SF/CPMs must be of the same type (p46). SFM6-7/12 needs the -B chassis 3HE10768AA (p44). An empty slot takes an impedance panel.","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"Nokia","maturity":"modelled","model":"7750 SR-12","name":"sr-12","profile":"networking","provenance":{"cable-management":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Key 1 (twice): the cable-management trays above and below the cage (p128 Figure 23, \"integral mounting brackets align with mounting holes ... above and below the module cage\"). Drawn as decor, flat: the top cover x 2.0-442.5, y 8.5-62.0 and the bottom cover y 511.5-565.6, corners rounded; a label band shaded on each (x 10.2-434.3, y 19.9-42.4 and 532.0-554.5); twelve cable slots along the rear edge of each cover, 16.3 wide at a 32.6 pitch from x 35.2 (profiles at y 11.5 and 562.5 agree to 0.1 mm); and two round fasteners on each cover, at (64.7, 47.6) and (379.6, 47.6) on the top one, (64.8, 526.2) and (379.9, 506.5) as drawn on the bottom one. The trays stand proud of the chassis (Table 25: 30.1 in deep with them against 25.4 without, so up to 119 mm), but how that depth divides between tray and cover is not drawn, so no stand-off is modelled. See gap cable-tray-depth."},"card-cage":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Twelve vertical slots on the family's slot unit U = 35.4 (the IOM4-e and IOM5-e figures are 425.45 x 35.4 exactly; the conventions' pitch). The 12 slots measure 424.2 across on p47, a pitch of 35.35; the boundaries read at 10.1, 45.3, 80.8, 115.4, 151.8, 186.3, 222.8, 258.2, 293.2, 329.3, 363.9, 400.3 and 434.4, all within 0.7 mm of 9.9 + 35.4k, so the bays sit at x = 9.9 + 35.4k from slot 1 to slot 10 in the printed order. Card tops read at y 76.1 along a blank slot and bottoms at 500-501.6, so the bays are 35.4 x 425.4 from y 75.9 (to 501.3)."},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"p90 Table 25: 24.5 x 17.5 x 25.4 in (62.23 x 44.45 x 64.51 cm) H x W x D without the cable-management unit, 30.1 in (764.5 mm) deep with it; 56.37 kg empty, about 155.4 kg loaded; bracket ears factory-installed to front-mount in a 19 in rack (p46). 14 RU. Ears are not modelled: the face is the 444.5 between the folds."},"colour":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"From the lab photographs (warm LED light, so hue relationships, not absolute values): a charcoal bezel and tray covers, drawn #34373c; a darker slot strip with white numerals; an orange A tag #e8742a and a light grey SFM tag #c8cacc; mid-grey side sheet metal. The rear is not photographed, so its colour is the front's, estimated."},"defaults":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Bay defaults follow what Figure 6 draws, with current-generation stand-ins for the legacy cards it shows. The figure draws IOM3-XP cards with classic MDAs in slots 1, 3, 5, 6, 8 and 10 (keys 3 and 5), slot impedance panels in 2, 4, 7 and 9 (key 4) and SF/CPM4 in A and B. The IOM3-XP and the classic MDAs are not modelled yet, so those six slots default to nokia/iom4-e@1 as a PLACEHOLDER (its MDA slots carry the MDA impedance panel by the carrier's own default) until nokia/iom3-xp exists and takes them over; A and B default to nokia/sfm4-12@1, which is both the figure's card and slot A in the photograph."},"esd":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"The front ESD plug (p47 key 9) sits in a grey box at x 413.3-438.7, y 603.0-621.5, jack centre (420.2, 609.5), which lies on the air-filter vent faceplate (x 3.6-440.6, y 565.6-622.6 as drawn). The nokia/sr-12-air-filter part draws the plate and leaves its honeycomb clear there (x 411.6-434.8, y 37.6-55.5 in the plate's own frame, 415.3-438.5 and 603.2-621.1 here); the chassis places common/esd-jack@1 on it, centred on the drawn jack. Figure 7 draws no rear ESD jack."},"fans":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Three vertical Enhanced Fan Tray slots across the rear, left to right as seen from behind, \"The left slot is designated as fan tray #1\" (p78). Bays are the tray's stated face, 139.7 x 447.0 (p104: 17.6 x 5.5 x 8.85 in), at x 9.9 / 151.6 / 293.4 (pitch 141.7), y 50.1; the figure draws the plates about 430 between the handle zones and 449.4 of free height between the ground plate and PEM 1, which the stated 447.0 fits. p78: trays are interchangeable in any fan slot."},"ground":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"p49 key 1, \"Grounding studs\": two hex-nut studs on the plate across the top of the rear, centres (22.5, 27.9) and (37.6, 27.9), the nuts 12.4 across corners, with an earth symbol in a black box at x 48.5-55.9, y 23.8-31.1. The plate is y 0-49.1, x 4.4-440.1. Drawn as decor (chassis metalwork with no part number). Stud length is not documented."},"legend":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"\"7750 SR-12\" over \"Service Router\" at the upper left of the top cover: Figure 6 sets it at x 18.2, baselines 30.7 and 35.0, cap heights 4.9 and 2.8 mm; the photograph prints it in white on the charcoal bezel at the same place."},"logo-zone":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"The photographed bezel carries an Alcatel-Lucent wordmark and glyph at the upper right of the top cover; the current -B chassis prints NOKIA. No vendor logo is drawn; the region is reserved."},"other-faces":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"No staged figure draws a side, the top or the bottom in elevation: p128 Figure 23 is an isometric of the rack with the trays, and the clearance figure is a plan outline."},"panel-scale":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Gate 1, front. p47 Figure 6 at 600 dpi: the flanges measure 3130 px across = 482.5 mm at 6.487 px/mm, and the body top to bottom 4042 px = 623.1 mm against the stated 622.3, so the figure is orthographic to 0.1 percent. Face frame: x = (px - 186.2) / 6.487 from the body's left fold (the body centred on the flanges), y = (px - 66) / 6.487 from the top edge. Positions were read off column and row profiles and a 5 mm grid laid over the render, good to about 0.5 mm."},"pems":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Two horizontal DC PEM-3 slots at the bottom of the rear, \"The top slot is designated slot 1\" (p46). Bays are the PEM-3's stated face, 425.7 x 51.6 (p104: 2.03 x 16.76 x 9.38 in), at x 11.1, y 498.6 and 551.2; drawn about 49 tall between y 500.4 and 551, the second ending at 602.7. The stated size is used. The plate below, y 602.8-622.3, is plain."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"No system maximum is stated. p102 Table 42 is an EXAMPLE budget, not an envelope: 6645 W worst case for the chassis at high fan RPM with PEM-3s and three fan trays (1185 W), ten 1-port 100GE CFP IMMs (4250 W), ten CFP optics (240 W) and two SFM5-12 + CPM5 (970 W). It is recorded here with that scope and power-max-w is not set from it; p93 notes that some FP4 configurations \"could exceed the maximum power capability of the chassis\". Input: DC only, -40 to -72 VDC into two load-sharing PEM-3s, each with two feeds; one PEM-3 carries the whole system and two give 1+1 (p77). PEM-3 ratings (p91 Table 27): 6480 W at -40 to -72 VDC (162 A), 8050 / 8575 / 8837.5 W on narrower ranges (175 A); the internal breaker is 175 A. AC sites use two external rectifier shelves, one per PEM: the OmniOn L20 3HE20675AA with four 2725 W CP2725AC54TE rectifiers, or the legacy Eltek HM1J 3HE04172AA with four 2500 W rectifiers (p71-72; p92 Tables 28-29); a shelf's status cable 3HE04173AA plugs into the PEM-3's DB-25 (p72)."},"rear-scale":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Gate 1, rear. p49 Figure 7 at 600 dpi measures 6.463 px/mm across (flanges 3119 px = 482.6) and 6.52 down (4058 px top to bottom for 622.3): the rear figure is drawn about 1 percent tall, so y was read on its own scale, y = (px - 218) / 6.52, and x = (px - 168.1) / 6.463."},"rotation":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"p46: \"Module slots are vertically oriented in the front of the chassis ... MDA slot 1 (top slot) or MDA slot 2 (bottom slot)\". Cards are authored horizontal (MDA slot 1 at the left, the Card Stat or 7750 SR CPM5 end at the left) and every card bay is rotate 90, clockwise: the left end goes to the TOP and the top edge to the RIGHT. The lab photographs agree five ways (the conventions' section 4): the IOM4-e's MDA slot 1 is on top; ME1-100GB-CFP2 and the IOM4-e tab legend read top to bottom; the lower MDA's Pwr is left of its Stat; the MDA-e screw lies near the column's right edge; 7750 SR CPM5 and Card Stat are at the top of their columns. A rotated bay's size is the ON-PANEL footprint and `at` its top-left corner; the renderer hangs the occupant at the bay centre."},"slot-numbering":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"p46: IOM slots are numbered 1 through 10 and \"the two center module slots, labeled A and B, are reserved for the SF/CPMs\". The chassis prints the order 1 2 3 4 5 A B 6 7 8 9 10 twice, on a strip above the cage (y 63.1-71.6) and again below it on the lower tray cover (y 512.1-520.4), each numeral centred on its slot. rel-pos is the printed number for the card slots and 1 = A, 2 = B for the SF/CPM slots."},"slot-strip":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"Figure 6 draws the strip grey with white numerals and, over the SF/CPM slots, a dark box printing A (x 197.0-205.1) and B (232.4-240.6) each followed by a white box printing SFM (205.1-220.4, 240.6-255.9); the strip itself stops at x 19.7 and 426.2. The lab photograph shows a dark strip with white numerals, an ORANGE A box and a light grey SFM box with dark lettering. The B box is not in frame: an orange edge at the photograph's right border, at the height of the A box and about one slot further on, is read as the B box and drawn orange too (a reading, not a sighting)."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"Written first. (1) 7450 ESS-12 and 7750 SR-12 Chassis Installation Guide 22.7, 3HE18644AAAATQZZA03 (the SR-12 guide; pages are the printed numbers, which are also the PDF pages): p47 Figure 6 (front) and p49 Figure 7 (rear) are the geometry, p44-46 the models and slot rules, p90-91 Tables 25-27 the chassis, environmental and PEM specifications, p102 Table 42 the example power budget, p108 Table 45 storage, p128 Figure 23 the cable-management trays. Both figures are VECTOR: pdfimages -list on p47 and p49 finds only 16-95 px icons, so a 600 dpi pdftocairo render is exact. (2) The owner's lab photographs of an installed SR-12, 2026-09-24 (working/intake/nokia/7750-sr/photos/lab-2026-09-24, four 1126 x 2000 phone shots in perspective; read for ratios, legends and colour only).
